about: Investigative Journey: the monsters it unlocks in order. Each step needs every requirement listed. "Server age" = days since your game server opened (the game compares against the server open time, so it differs per server). Studies = Investigation Notes studies (objectives) completed.

requirements.text: Complete 5 Investigation Notes studies of Pink Rathian

steps.what_unlocking_does: Once unlocked, this monster has a chance to appear in the field (requires reaching Ecological Rank 6). Its lair will also be unlocked simultaneously (requires unlocking lair Difficulty IV first).
steps.unlocked_message: Radiant Paolumu's lair has been unlocked (requires unlocking lair Difficulty IV first). Radiant Paolumu may now appear in the field (requires reaching Ecological Rank 6).
